name: printfection-uk
description: Printfection UK - Bulk garment printing eCommerce platform

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev -w @printfection/api" "npm run dev -w @printfection/storefront" "npm run dev -w @printfection/admin"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @printfection/types && npm run build -w @printfection/config && npm run build -w @printfection/shared && npm run build -w @printfection/api && npm run build -w @printfection/storefront && npm run build -w @printfection/admin
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @printfection/api && npm run typecheck -w @printfection/storefront && npm run typecheck -w @printfection/admin
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @printfection/api && npm run lint -w @printfection/storefront && npm run lint -w @printfection/admin
